messages:
maria: Kicking off the image-propagation run for eu-north1 -> eu-west4. Goal: GitOps/Helm deploys in eu-west4 pick up images from regional mirror. Quick status: registry replication job started, but seeing 503s from mirror occasionally.
aj: Copying the root thread here. Which registry mirror are we using for eu-west4? gcr or our regional proxy?
maria: Using redwood-registry-eu (artifacts.redwood-infra.internal). It's a regional mirror backed by cross-project GCR buckets. Replication tool is artifact-syncer (k8s CronJob).
kevin: FYI I've reserved a small GPU pool in eu-west4 (2xA40) for smoke e2e. Not huge—can run basic helm chart installs and a couple of pods.
sana: First checks:
- IAM bindings exist for artifact-syncer service account
- Bucket lifecycle and requester pays disabled
- VPC-SC not enabled in target

All good on those.
maria: logs from the syncer (tail):
```
2026-03-12T09:02:41Z INFO starting sync job for project/redwood-core
2026-03-12T09:03:00Z WARN http 503 trying GET https://eu-west4-mirror/artifacts/sha256:... retrying
2026-03-12T09:03:12Z INFO pulled manifest for model-llama2:quantized
2026-03-12T09:03:35Z ERROR push failed: storage class mismatch for blob xyz
```
aj: storage class mismatch — likely the source object is nearline and target bucket is standard, or vice versa. We recently changed default storage class on the mirror bucket.
oliver: Can we just set `--force-set-storage-class=STANDARD` in the syncer? Artifact sizes are huge so avoid nearline for frequently pulled images.
kevin: Agreed. But watch costs - STANDARD for cold artifacts increases cost. For model shards we want STANDARD in regional mirrors for fast pulls.
maria: Proposed quick fix: flip syncer flag to force standard on new objects, and trigger backfill for the most-used tags only (model-llama2, llama-micro). Backfill plan:
1) Run dry-run to list affected blobs
2) Run targeted copy for top 5 tags
3) Monitor egress + cost channel

Anyone object?
jen: No objections. Add a rollout throttle: 2 concurrent copies to avoid saturating mirror egress.
sana: Also bump the CronJob backoff to 6 and add `--retries=5` to reduce noisy failures.
deploy-bot: deploy requested: artifact-syncer configmap update -> sha:abc123
deploy-bot: rollout started for cronjob/artifact-syncer (namespace infra)
maria: After rolling the config, I got one successful copy, then another 503. Trace shows conn resets from internal proxy.
aj: Proxy layer seems to be the regional load-balancer. Checking LB logs now.
aj: LB logs show connection drops at ~09:03:20 from proxy-connpool-exhaustion. Current connection limit is 200.
oliver: For big artifact transfers we should allow up to 600 connections. Can you patch the lb config? It's managed by infra-lb-controller.
aj: Filed terraform change: PR #5423 to increase backend max_conn to 600 and add healthcheck timeout bump.
kevin: While infra does that, we can reduce concurrency at the syncer to 1 and add exponential backoff to avoid thrashing.
sana: Also recommend enabling chunked uploads on mirror if supported (resumable) — reduces failed large pushes.
maria: Rolling back concurrency to 1 now and restarting syncer. Monitoring.
(maria edits): Added a small helm hook in the chart to run `kubectl exec` smoke pull against the mirror after sync completes.
kevin: Smoke pull looks good. Pod pulled 3 image layers, GPU node scheduled, container started, vram ok.
aj: LB change merged to staging. We'll promote after 1h if no regressions.
jen: Cost note: changing storage class to STANDARD for top tags will add ~$1.8k/month. Put on cost-alerts tag: eng-infra/region-boots.
oliver: also tag copied objects with `replicated_by=artifact-syncer` and `region=eu-west4` for analytics.
maria: Next steps checklist:
- [x] force-storage-class=STANDARD in syncer config
- [x] throttled concurrency -> 1
- [x] backoff/retries increased
- [x] LB backend max_conn PR opened
- [x] helm hook smoke pull added
- [ ] schedule backfill for top-5 tags during off-peak (after 22:00 UTC)
- [ ] cost approval for STANDARD for those tags

aj: I'll watch the LB rollout and post updates here.
sana: I'll put a short runbook note under docs/region-onboard for this storage-class caveat.
maria: Thanks everyone — great cross-team response. Will update thread after backfill.
kevin: thumbs up :thumbsup:
